data.one_liner: A fully customizable gauge widget for Flutter with multiple segments and styling options.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable gauge widget for Flutter applications. It supports multiple segments with individual lengths and colors, custom needle colors, minimum and maximum markers, and customizable display widgets for values and text.
use_when: You need to display a gauge or meter (such as a speedometer or fuel gauge) in your Flutter app.
You require custom segments, colors, and markers on a gauge.
You want to display current values with custom text and display widgets inside a gauge.
avoid_when: You need complex charting types other than gauges, such as line, bar, or pie charts.
You need non-square dimensions for your gauge.
strengths: Fully customizable segments, colors, and needle styling.
Supports customizable display widgets and markers for min and max values.
Built from scratch for Flutter with null safety support.

alternatives.name: syncfusion_flutter_gauges
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick it for a more robust, feature-rich suite of gauge components from a major vendor.

alternatives.name: gauge_indicator
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick it as an alternative implementation for displaying gauge indicators in Flutter.

data.minimal_example:
PrettyGauge(
    gaugeSize: 200,
    segments: [
        GaugeSegment('Low', 20, Colors.red),
        GaugeSegment('Medium', 40, Colors.orange),
        GaugeSegment('High', 40, Colors.green),
    ],
    currentValue: 46,
    displayWidget: Text('Fuel in tank', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12)),
)
